structural_change: Replace raw-pin TritonCTS with separate real physical clock spines for all five named roots. Every hard macro clock pin is a distinct leaf; actual CLOSED child boundary insertion sets its target. Physical buffers pad early PMA and parent-register branches. Original geometry, RTL, six actual landings and all data/reset ages stay identical. No300ps decoder waiver. sp11 (STW-S81c-COLLA-SERDES 10-22): spine child targets made corner-consistent (ot_sp_leaf_arrivals reads the WC/SS scene; hard-child refs now SS boundary means via clock_tap_ps = TT-SS), fixing the measured sp10b ck_tx TT 89.0 ps (enc raw 125.9 + 286.4 late vs soft 345-371).
